_comment: Manual additions/overrides merged over api_allowlist.json (generated from PLAN.md Appendix A).
Sections: globals, static ('Root.Member' / 'Root:Method', wildcards allowed), methods (':Name' without receiver),
events ('Events.X', 'GameEvents.X', 'LuaEvents.X'), gameinfo (table names), base_includes (base-game include name ->
globals it defines), forbidden ([{name, why}] extra forbidden identifiers).
Levels: C confirmed; L likely; NV new-verify; PENDING waits for an in-game test. Anything but C prints a WARN.
Add an entry here only with evidence (base-game file:line or a closed in-game test) and put it in refs.

2026-09-28 Session A in-game results (research/phase0_results/SESSION_A_REPORT.md): entries marked 'Session A' come from the Phase 0 harness. A context missing from an entry with replace=true means the call is UNAVAILABLE there (nil in that Lua state): using it is an ERROR.

WP1.7 additions (2026-09-28): LuaEvents.DiplomacyActionView_HideIngameUI, MilitaryFormationTypes.CORPS_FORMATION, UI.GetHeadSelectedCity (evidence in refs). Events.X.Remove / LuaEvents.X.Remove are accepted for every allowlisted event (base UnitFlagManager.lua:2000-2002 Events.PlayerTurnActivated.Remove / Events.UnitAddedToMap.Remove; InGame.lua:371 / PiratesIntro.lua:139 LuaEvents pattern); api_audit checks the member (.Add / .Remove / call).

Phase 2 / Session C integration (2026-09-28): GameEvents.PlayerTurnStarted (G C, fires for every player, Session C T04), GameEvents.OnPlayerTurnEnded downgraded to L (registered but never fires in GS single player, Session C; api_audit warns on every use), GameInfo.UnitUpgrades (unit identity check: upgrade chain).

Sessions D/E integration (2026-09-28): GameEvents.OnGameTurnEnded (G C, Session E T26: once per round, after the engine heal; EFV's mutiny-floor boundary), notes on GameEvents.PlayerTurnStarted / PlayerTurnStartComplete (every living player incl. the human), Events.PlayerDefeat / PlayerDestroyed (G C, after the units are gone), GameEvents.PlayerDefeat (L, never fired), deal items GetDuration / GetEnactedTurn (G C), FindItemByType / GetFromPlayerID confirmed by behaviour (Session D T09/T19), HasAllied / HasDeclaredFriendship G only (nil/err in UI, Session E), city GetGold nil in G (Session D T09). Not added for rules: Events.PlayerTurnDeactivated, Events.TurnEnd (fire in G but are asynchronous UI events).

Session F integration (0.5.2, 2026-09-28): GameInfo.UnitReplaces / CivilizationTraits / LeaderTraits (upgrade into a civilization's unique unit, T30), PlayerConfigurations :GetCivilizationTypeName / :GetLeaderTypeName (owner of the unique unit), Events.UnitUpgraded (G, async: carries the NEW unit ID; not used for rules), UnitManager.PlaceUnit G confirmed (T29; EFV_Dev only).

EFV_Dev 0.6.0-dev.1 final-session scenarios (2026-09-28): :GetTechs / :SetTech (G, grant the upgrade target's tech, S5), GameInfo.Technologies, and the UI promotion command UnitManager.RequestCommand(unit, UnitCommandTypes.PROMOTE, { [UnitCommandTypes.PARAM_PROMOTION_TYPE] = index }) for the S6 veteran route B. EFV_Dev only.

EFV_Dev 0.6.1-dev.1 (2026-09-28): the final session starts from a brand-new game, so S0 (and S5/S7/S11) build what a new game lacks: PlayersVisibility :ChangeVisibilityCount (reveal), :GetCulture / :SetCivic (Early Empire for open borders, S5 target civic), the scripted open-borders deal (DealManager working deal, DealDirection.OUTGOING, :AddItemOfType / :SetSubType / :SetDuration / :SetLocked / :Validate), CityManager.GetDistrictAt + DefenseTypes (city HP / walls for S7 / S11), UnitManager.RestoreMovementToFormation (created unit without moves), GameInfo.Civics. EFV_Dev only; evidence in refs.
